name: flc-file-include
description: WordPress Gutenberg block to include HTML files from the filesystem.

scripts.plugin:zip: npm run build && cd .. && zip -r flc-file-include.zip flc-file-include -x 'flc-file-include/node_modules/*' -x 'flc-file-include/src/*' -x 'flc-file-include/.git/*' -x 'flc-file-include/.claude/*' -x 'flc-file-include/CLAUDE.md' -x 'flc-file-include/.gitignore' -x 'flc-file-include/package*.json' -x 'flc-file-include/citrus-ax-2026-03-19.html'
